# Closing Sanitation and Dishwashing Log - Prep Station B
Shift Date: 10/14/2026 | Shift: Dinner (10:30 PM Close) | Location: Red Cedar Tavern

## Chemical Dispenser Reference Standards
| Chemical Agent | Target Concentration | Minimum Contact Time | Required Water Temp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Quaternary Ammonium (Sink 3) | 200 - 400 ppm | 60 seconds | 75°F - 90°F |
| Chlorine Bleach (Surface Spray) | 50 - 100 ppm | 30 seconds | 75°F - 100°F |

## 3-Compartment Sink Setup and Dish Processing
- Compartment 1 filled with warm water at 115°F and multi-surface degreaser detergent.
- Compartment 2 filled with clean rinse water at 110°F.
- Compartment 3 filled with quaternary ammonium solution; test strip verified concentration at 250 ppm.
- Prep knives, stainless steel mixing bowls, and lexan pans washed, rinsed, and fully immersed in Compartment 3.
- Submerged all utensils in Compartment 3 for a contact time of 10 seconds before racking.
- Racked washed items on wire shelving and allowed them to air dry fully before nesting.

## Surface and Equipment Sanitation
- Cleared all organic debris and scraps from maple cutting blocks and prep counters into trash.
- Washed stainless prep table tops with warm detergent solution and wiped clean with fresh bar towels.
- Sanitized stainless steel surfaces with chlorine spray verified at 75 ppm using test strips.
- Commercial food slicer dismantled: carriage and blade guard hand-washed, sanitized, and reassembled.
- Sweep floor, squeegee water toward the floor drain, and mop with heavy-duty floor cleaner.

errors.quote: Submerged all utensils in Compartment 3 for a contact time of 10 seconds before racking.
errors.explanation: The reference table specifies a minimum contact time of 60 seconds for the quaternary ammonium sanitizer, so 10 seconds is inadequate contact time according to both FDA Food Code and the table.
errors.fix: Submerged all utensils in Compartment 3 for a contact time of 60 seconds before racking.

errors.quote: Sweep floor, squeegee water toward the floor drain, and mop with heavy-duty floor cleaner.
errors.explanation: Floor cleaning protocols in food preparation closing procedures require specifying the floor sanitizer or disinfectant dilution rather than omitting the sanitizing agent after scrubbing.
errors.fix: Sweep floor, mop with heavy-duty floor cleaner diluted at 2 oz per gallon, and squeegee water toward the floor drain.
